plan: My goal is to maximize profit. Given my value is $39 and the bidding range is $0-$49, I should bid aggressively. To ensure I win if the second-highest bid is below my value, I will bid at the maximum possible value, $49. This guarantees I win if any opponent bids below $49, and I will never pay more than my value.

My goal is to maximize profit. Since I pay the second-highest bid if I win, bidding above my value is safe. Given the rules, bidding my value ensures I win whenever my value is higher than the second-highest bid, maximizing my profit in the long run.
